notify.name: Notifications
notify.description: Tells you what happened — in the app now, and through the channels you connect.

settings.quietHoursHint: Messages to your channels wait until the window ends. The bell fills in immediately either way.
settings.devicesHint: Push notifications go to the browsers you connect here.
settings.pushConnected: This device will now receive notifications

push.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in this browser
push.insecure: Push needs a secure address — open the app over https, or on localhost

settings.loadFailed: Could not load your notification settings
settings.externalHint: This plugin runs in its own container: what goes here leaves the instance, with its text and your contact.
settings.inboxAlways: The bell in the header always shows everything. These settings decide only what else leaves the app.
settings.logHint: What was sent, what failed, and how many attempts it took.
settings.connectHere: Notifications go to the browser you press this in.
settings.connectElsewhere: Another device connects on itself: open MakeKeeper in its browser and press "Connect this device" there.
settings.forgetConfirm: Forget “{name}”? Notifications stop reaching it immediately, and only that browser can subscribe again.

api.counts: Unread counts, in total and per plugin
api.quietFrom: Start of the quiet window, in minutes from local midnight
api.quietTo: End of the quiet window, in minutes from local midnight
api.timezone: IANA timezone the quiet window is read in
api.snoozeMinutes: How long to put it off, in minutes
api.locale: Language a channel message is written in
api.types: List the notification types plugins declared
api.setRoute: Write one cell of the matrix
api.routeType: Notification type the rule is about
api.routeEnabled: Whether that type may use that channel
api.pushEndpoint: Push service endpoint the browser issued
api.pushLabel: Name to tell this device apart by
api.setChannelEnabled: Switch one channel on or off for the caller
api.channelEnabled: Whether the caller uses that channel at all

actions.nothingToSnooze: There is nothing to postpone here.
actions.unknownHook: Whatever this button did is no longer available.
actions.destructive: Actions that delete data can only be confirmed in the app.
actions.failed: That did not work. Try it in the app.

errors.noSubscription: This person has no device connected for push.
errors.everyDeviceFailed: Push failed for every connected device: {detail}
